name: Computer Parts Courier Routing
description: A demonstration model for selecting one of three couriers for computer-part orders. Version 1 predicates compare one payload value at a time, so courierRoutingProfile is a derived, mutually exclusive value calculated from addressScope, areaType, itemSize, fragile, sameDayFeePaid, and the selected product's restrictions.

parameters.name: Area type
parameters.description: Local delivery area: urban or rural.

parameters.name: Item size
parameters.description: Parcel size: small, medium, or large.

parameters.name: Fragile
parameters.description: Whether the packed product requires fragile handling.

parameters.name: Same-day fee paid
parameters.description: Whether the customer paid the optional same-day delivery fee.

parameters.name: Courier routing profile
parameters.description: Derived route: local-standard, local-same-day, international, or unavailable.

payloads.name: Order routing payload
payloads.description: Reusable order details used by every product event in this demonstration.

events.name: Desktop CPU
events.description: Small, non-fragile parcel. International sale and local same-day delivery are allowed.

events.name: Graphics Card
events.description: Medium, fragile parcel. International sale is allowed; same-day delivery is not allowed because the parcel is fragile.

events.name: ATX Motherboard
events.description: Medium, fragile parcel. International sale is allowed; same-day delivery is not allowed because the parcel is fragile.

events.name: Full-Tower Desktop Case
events.description: Large, non-fragile parcel. International sale is allowed; same-day delivery is not allowed because the parcel is large.

events.name: DDR5 Memory Kit
events.description: Small, non-fragile parcel. International sale and local same-day delivery are allowed.

events.name: NVMe Solid-State Drive
events.description: Small, non-fragile parcel. International sale and local same-day delivery are allowed.

events.name: Mechanical Hard Drive
events.description: Small, fragile parcel. International sale is allowed; same-day delivery is not allowed because the parcel is fragile.

events.name: Modular Power Supply
events.description: Medium, non-fragile parcel. International sale and local same-day delivery are allowed.

events.name: Ultrawide Gaming Monitor
events.description: Large, fragile parcel. International sale is allowed; same-day delivery is not allowed because the parcel is large and fragile.

events.name: Mechanical Keyboard
events.description: Medium, non-fragile parcel. International sale and local same-day delivery are allowed.

events.name: Liquid Cooling Kit
events.description: Medium, fragile parcel containing coolant. This demonstration supplier restricts it to local standard delivery; international sale and same-day delivery are unavailable.

events.name: UPS Battery Backup
events.description: Large parcel containing a regulated battery. This demonstration supplier restricts it to local standard delivery; international sale and same-day delivery are unavailable.

conditions.name: Address is local
conditions.description: Describes the raw destination scope used to derive the mutually exclusive courier routing profile.

conditions.name: Address is international
conditions.description: Describes the raw destination scope used to derive the mutually exclusive courier routing profile.

conditions.name: Address is urban
conditions.description: Same-day delivery requires a local urban address.

conditions.name: Address is rural
conditions.description: Rural local orders use standard local delivery rather than same-day delivery.

conditions.name: Package is small
conditions.description: A raw package-size condition used when deriving same-day eligibility.

conditions.name: Package is medium
conditions.description: A raw package-size condition used when deriving same-day eligibility.

conditions.name: Package is large
conditions.description: Large packages cannot use same-day delivery.

conditions.name: Package is fragile
conditions.description: Fragile packages cannot use same-day delivery.

conditions.name: Package is not fragile
conditions.description: Non-fragile handling is required for same-day delivery.

conditions.name: Same-day fee is paid
conditions.description: The customer must pay the extra fee before same-day delivery can be selected.

conditions.name: Route by standard local courier
conditions.description: The derived routing profile is local-standard. It covers local rural orders and local urban orders that are not eligible for same-day delivery.

conditions.name: Route by same-day courier
conditions.description: The derived routing profile is local-same-day: local, urban, fee paid, not large, not fragile, and allowed for the selected product.

conditions.name: Route by international courier
conditions.description: The derived routing profile is international and the selected product is available for export.

actions.name: Use International Delivery Service
actions.description: Select the international courier for an export-eligible product sent to an international address.

actions.name: Use Local Delivery Service
actions.description: Select the standard local courier for local urban or rural delivery.

actions.name: Use Same-Day Delivery Service
actions.description: Select the extra-fee same-day courier for an eligible product sent to a local urban address.
